The record describes a new or experimental technology being tested or deployed — for example, cameras or sensors mounted on test vehicles to develop a new driving-assistance feature. In its 2022 decision on Volkswagen, Germany's data protection authority for Lower Saxony found that the company tested a camera-based driving-assistance system without carrying out a DPIA — a breach of Article 35 — and without a data-processing agreement with the third party running the tests. That finding cuts against the company's position here. But the outcome depends on this company's own facts: whether the technology is genuinely novel to this kind of processing, and whether an assessment was completed and documented before testing began. Section 1 records whether that trigger is satisfied. (Data Protection Authority of Lower Saxony, Volkswagen, decision of 26 July 2022; supervisory-authority decision — persuasive, non-binding outside its jurisdiction.)
